name: JMD
description: Just My Dog custom edits, typically 5-6 minutes. 1080p is included even though an H.264 master at that height is skipped rather than encoded: a preset states what deliverable is WANTED, and the encoder decides whether that means encoding or linking the master. An HEVC master would make 1080p a real encode. The skip is also recorded, so the run report shows it happened.
